correctness.rationale: The infimal-convolution gauge of conv(B1^d ∪ k^{-1}B∞^d) equals sum_{i<=m} x_(i)+(k-m)x_(m+1), m=floor k. Ordered absolute gaps y_i=x_(i)-x_(i+1) transform each sign/order chamber into a weighted simplex with c_i=min(i,k). Exact volume 2^d/(m! k^(d-m)) and Dirichlet(1,...,1) second moments give the displayed isotropic covariance formula. On chamber m<k<m+1, derivative sign reduces to the increasing quadratic 2k²+(d-2m)k-(d-m+1)(d+2m+2)/3. Its root is an interior candidate only for b_d<m<a_d. At integers the directional derivative changes in the non-minimum direction; endpoints have opposite derivative signs. The candidate interval contains at most two integers. Stirling yields limiting F(alpha)=e^{-2alpha}(1+3alpha²+2alpha³)/12, uniquely minimized at (sqrt3-1)/2, value e^(1-sqrt3)/8. Independent symbolic/rational checks verified derivative, 29 dimensions of candidate bounds and limiting expression; finite checks are not the proof.
